name: print-social-feel-the-design-neon-instagram-pack-dark-green-purple
title: '#FeelTheDesign' Instagram pack in black with neon green-to-purple duotone portraits and glitch grid lines
whatItIs: Nine black square posts with neon green-to-purple duotone photos of designers, glitchy dot-grid and line textures, bold condensed headlines ('MEET THE TEAM', 'IDEAS THAT GROW', 'CREATIVE TRENDS'), a 'Workshop' pill tag, and small logo marks with hashtag branding.
whatItMeans: Edgy and futuristic; neon duotone and glitch textures make a design studio feel technical and forward-thinking.
techniques: Duotone photos in clashing neon colours for a glitch feel.
Add fine dot-grid and line textures as tech decoration.
Use a consistent hashtag as a recurring brand device.

vocabulary.definition: Visual noise or distortion mimicking digital error.
Using a consistent hashtag as part of visual identity.
